nom: CHANEL LA MOUSSE Camellia Cleansing Cream-to-Foam

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily, acne-prone skin say the cleanser lifts excess oil, grime and makeup while still leaving skin balanced rather than stripped.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers mostly describe the formula as hydrating and non-stripping, though a couple mention it can feel slightly drying or tight, especially in winter or with daily use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including ones with rosacea or a dry-leaning complexion in winter, generally report effective cleansing without irritation or breakouts, though one found it a bit too harsh and not thorough enough for removing makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with eczema or rosacea, mostly report no irritation or breakouts, but several flag the fragrance as a concern and one warns daily use could be too harsh for drier, reactive skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer notes the formula works well on normal to combination skin and is gentle enough for daily use.
segments.mature: A reviewer with mature, sensitive skin calls it a favorite she recommends without hesitation.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, say the cleanser rinses away without leaving skin tight or dry and can even feel hydrating afterward; a minority describe it as stripping or slightly drying, particularly in winter or with daily use on already-dry or sensitive skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin mostly report the cleanser doesn't clog pores or trigger new breakouts, even with daily use; one reviewer felt the strong fragrance itself seemed to make her acne-prone skin flare up.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say it lifts excess oil, sunscreen and makeup effectively while still leaving skin feeling balanced rather than over-stripped.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers with eczema-prone or reactive skin say the cleanser did not strip or aggravate their compromised barrier, with one reporting visible improvement in barrier comfort and moisture over time.
concerns.redness: Reviewers managing rosacea or an active eczema flare report no increase in redness or irritation after switching to this cleanser.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I like this cleanser because it is a cream to foam formulation. the foam is very fine does. It provide a full lather. Just slightly bubbles up on the skin but still looks creamy to me. It also is very scented which I feel makes my skin flare up and for people with sensitive skin that much fragrance is not necessary. outside of those cons, the pros were smooth application and an amazing clean feel after rinsing the product off. It is quite stripping of the oils in your face, which I think leads to that very clean feel on the skin so heavy moisturizer following cleansing with this product is important. all in all if they were to release a fragrance free version, it would be my number one choice for facial cleanser, but with the amount of fragrance in it, it literally smells like a body fragrance and that's no good for my acne prone skin.

extraits.titre: Decent for a non-skincare brand cleanser
extraits.texte: It cleans well, a little too well for sensitive/dry skin. Left me feeling a little too stripped and squeaky clean. Packaging is boring, and the scent is reminiscent of old lady, but that's Chanel for you. All that said, it does make me feel fancy for using a luxury bland for something so silly as a cleanser. Wouldn't outright buy, but I'll enjoy using it as a splurge. Thanks for the free sample!

The La Mousse Cleanser from Chanel is one of the best cleansers I've tried. When squeezed out of the tube it is a very thick consistency that foams up when rubbed in yours hands with water. It is incredibly hydrating and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft and moisturized after use. As someone with very dry skin I really value a cleanser that doesn't strip my skin and make it feel drier than it already is. This does have a pretty strong fragrance, which is typical with designer skincare and beauty products. It doesn't bother me but if you're sensitive to fragrance it's something to consider. This is obviously a pricy cleanser but a little goes a very long way and after using it for over 3 weeks I've barely put a dent in it so it will definitely last a long time. All in all it's a cleanser I'd recommend to anyone wanting to try some designer skincare. * I received this product for free from Bzzagent and Chanel in exchange for my honest review.*

This is a cream to foam facial cleanser that has an amazing fragrance and seems suitable for a lot of skin types. Personally I have oily, acne prone skin and am prone to breakouts. This cleanser has kept my skin clean yet hydrated and nourished. It builds up a great lather and also has an amazing scent. I use this product twice daily, once in the morning and once at night. I would say that the scent may be a bit too strong/perfume-y for a facial cleanser but personally I don't mind the scent. I would recommend this product to my friends and family. I recieved this product for free in exchange for writing this review.

I did not know that face wash could feel so luxurious! I received Chanel's LA MOUSSE face wash for free to review. I'm actually obsessed. I have combination skin and rosacea and my skin can be sensitive to new products, but this face wash has been so effective and so gentle. It's cream to foam and feels so soft and cushy going on, but is effective at removing dirt, oil, and sunscreen. I've been using it twice a day for a week and my skin feels so fresh, clean, and radiant. I've actually been receiving a lot of compliments on my skin since I started using LA MOUSSE. I haven't had any issues with drying or stripping and my skin feels healthy and hydrated. I usually stay away from scented products, but find that the soft, floral scent has enhanced my experience with this product. It feels and smells so luxurious that I actually look forward to washing my face at the end of the day! It is a little expensive for a facial cleanser, but I have found that you can use a very small amount and still have a full face lather, so I think it's worth it!

The scent is the most beautiful floral scent that makes cleansing a spa experience! Pleasantly surprised with how effective the cleanser is at removing makeup and sunscreen even removing the majority of my extra waterproof mascara! I know it is not necessarily meant to be used as a cleansing balm but I wanted to test the cleanser in different trials. It is not stripping even on my eczema prone skin that was having a flare up prior to using this cleanser I had to layer 3 different moisturizers to keep it from flaking meanwhile immediately after washing my skin feels throughly clean but not stripped of all moisture. It doesn't clog pores nor cause breakouts either in my acne prone skin. I would definetly recommend it and as frugal as I am even I would splurge on this product! Disclaimer: I received this product free from Bzzagent for testing purposes but the opinions expressed remain 100% my own honest thoughts.

extraits.titre: A Luxe Cleanser that Truly Delivers
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser. It's rich, luxuriously smooth, removes makeup effortlessly, and leaves my skin soft and refreshed. I've been using it morning and night followed by serum and moisturizer, and compared to other products I've tried—including the French olive oil soap I was using before—La Mousse is on a completely different level. It's a luxe cleanser that truly delivers. While it is pricey, I absolutely intend to repurchase. You only need the smallest amount each time, so it's surprisingly cost-effective and one tube will last a long time. My mature sensitive skin and I love La Mousse and recommend it without hesitation. Thank you to Chanel for gifting me the Chanel La Mousse Cream-to-Foam Cleanser in exchange for my honest review.
